config.script:
tagvalue=system.tag.readBlocking([self.session.custom.machineInfo.basePath+"/WO/status",self.session.custom.machineInfo.basePath+"/Downtime/Ongoingbreakdown"])
	currentmachinestatus=tagvalue[0].value
	machinefaultstatus=tagvalue[1].value
	if currentmachinestatus == 0:
		if machinefaultstatus==False :
			serialnumber=self.view.params.value.serial_number
			programnumber=self.view.params.value.program_name
			workstatus=self.view.params.value.work_status
			PO=self.view.params.value.PO
			params = {"secondaryText":" Are you sure you want to start this "+str(serialnumber) +" job with program number " + str(programnumber)+ " ?","program_name":str(programnumber),"serial_number":str(serialnumber),"work_status":workstatus,"PO":PO}
			system.perspective.openPopup("PopUp", view = "Project/Pop-Up/Job_start_confirm", 
												params = params, 
												showCloseIcon = False,
												draggable = False, 
												modal = True)
		else :										
			params = {"action":"error", "primaryText": "Error occured! Active downtime detected!", "secondaryText":"Please complete the ongoing downtime or wait until it is finished."}
			system.perspective.openPopup("PopUp", view = "Project/Pop-Up/Pop-up", 
												params = params, 
												showCloseIcon = False,
												draggable = False, 
												modal = True)										
												
	else:
		params = {"action":"error", "primaryText": "Error occured! Already job running!", "secondaryText":"Please cancel work in progress job from 'Work In Progress' screen to start a new one!"}
		system.perspective.openPopup("PopUp", view = "Project/Pop-Up/Pop-up", 
											params = params, 
											showCloseIcon = False,
											draggable = False, 
											modal = True)
